DR-006, DR-007 and DR-009 currently carry no note, so appending is correct rather than duplicating, and DR-011 is the only row left undisposed. consentNote: I CONSENT with zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX. What distinguishes this entry is how much it declines to do: it will not rewrite D-070's regeneration sentence, will not change the snapshot heading date, and will not touch the six existing notes. Those are the clauses I tested hardest, because a declination is only safe if the thing being declined is already true — and each one is: the two-axis sentence is in the register, the heading already reads 2026-08-14, and the row it proposes to replace is verbatim the '6 of 11' text D-070 left there. The nine-row count is right, DR-011 stays the sole undisposed row, and the DR-009 cell carries the rider with the correct head digest rather than flattening it into a bare disposition reference.
